[[File:Bronze full helm chathead.png|left]]
The '''bronze full helmet''' is the weakest [[full helmet]] in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. The bronze full helmet grants greater defensive bonuses than its [[Bronze medium helmet|medium helmet counterpart]], though at a cost of offensive bonuses for [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]]. There are no [[Defence]] requirements for wearing this helmet.

To create a bronze full helmet the player needs at least 7 Smithing, a [[hammer]] and 2 [[bronze bar]]s. To make a helmet use one of the bars on an [[anvil]] with the hammer in the inventory. This grants 25 Smithing experience.
